incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-4721 fired: eval-gate:production:output-quality-regression. Trigger: safety_gate_trip (toxicity). Details: pass_rate dropped 98% -> 72% over last 5m, avg_toxicity_score 0.18 (baseline 0.02). Affected route: /v1/generate (model redwood-v2-small-q8, rollout: canary=15%). Logs & eval snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/PD-4721

alex (oncall): Acked. Looking now. Any immediate customer impacts? :eyes:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4721 acknowledged by alex.

maya (ml-eng): seeing same on the safety eval harness. Failing buckets: profanity, do_not_generate, and hallucination-clarity tests. The spike aligns with the canary rollout of redwood-v2-small-q8 at ~1860123000.

jordan (sre): Checking routing & traffic split. If canary at 15%, this could explain a subset of customer requests seeing the regression. Pulling per-route error/quality heatmap now.

ellie (pm): Heads up — we have 2 active enterprise customers ondedicated routes that route 10% traffic to canaries. They may see degraded outputs. Support, please prepare the standard customer note.

tyler (support): copying. Preparing initial customer message draft. Will wait for confirmation on mitigation path before sending.

alex (oncall): Short mitigation proposal:
1) Pause canary rollout (set canary weight -> 0%)
2) Route traffic for /v1/generate to redwood-v2-small-q4 fallback for 10m while we investigate
3) Disable automatic rollouts for model catalog entries until root cause identified

Can we do 1+2 quickly?

maya (ml-eng): Agreed. Quick rollback of rollout weight is fastest. I can patch the rollout policy via control plane.

jordan (sre): I can apply routing override for the route to force-model redwood-v2-small-q4. Command I will run:
```
# force route override
redwoodctl routes set --route "/v1/generate" --force-model redwood-v2-small-q4 --ttl 600
```

alex (oncall): Doing ticketed action. jordan, please run and post result. maya, please pause the canary in the catalog UI and pin previous stable model if possible.

jordan (sre): Ran override. Response:
```
OK: route /v1/generate now forced to redwood-v2-small-q4 (TTL 600s)
Applied at 1860123459 by jordan
```

incident-bot: Routing override applied. Notifying affected services.

maya (ml-eng): Paused canary in model catalog and pinned redwood-v2-small-q4 as stable for the route. Also snapshotting failing evals for postmortem.

alex (oncall): Monitoring quality metrics. Can we get a quick delta after the override? maya/jordan, post 2-min snapshot.

maya (ml-eng): 2-min post-override snapshot: pass_rate 97.8%, avg_toxicity_score 0.03. Looks like routing fix mitigated the blast radius. Will continue watching.

ellie (pm): Great. Tyler, draft to customers:
"We detected a regression impacting a subset of generation requests due to a canary model rollout. We have paused the rollout and applied a routing override to restore previous model behavior. We are investigating root cause and will share a timeline within 4 hours."

tyler (support): Drafted and queued. Sending to customers affected by canary now. (Will BCC internal distro)

alex (oncall): Next steps:
- maya to own root cause analysis (ML model behavior / training change / quantization mismatch)
- jordan to verify infra/serving logs for tokenization/kv-cache anomalies
- ellie to coordinate customer comms and follow-ups
- alex to prepare incident document and handoff to sam (next oncall) at shift change

maya (ml-eng): Initial signal: failure mode more pronounced in prompts with multi-turn safety patterns and long context. Suspect q8 quantization on new build interacting with adaptive-kv-cache eviction. I will reproduce locally against canary binary.

jordan (sre): No infra exceptions in the node-level metrics. Network/latency stable. TTLs and caches OK from infra side.

alex (oncall): Logging the incident: https://incidents.redwood.ai/PD-4721. Assigning severity: sev2 (customer visible degradation, mitigated for now). ETA for RCA draft: 12 hours.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4721 escalated to engineering@redwood.ai after 10m no-resolve (escalation timer cleared by ack).

ellie (pm): Pls collect representative prompts and responses for eval team. Maya, I'll drop a folder in the evals link with customer-safe redactions.

maya (ml-eng): Will do. Will also run targeted evals: 1) q8 vs q4 on the failing buckets 2) kv-cache stress tests 3) sequence-length sensitivity.

alex (oncall): Handoff: sam (oncall-next) — I'll tag you in the incident doc and slack when my shift ends at 1860123800. Current state: routing override active, canary paused, customers notified, RCA in progress. Anything you need to carry?

sam (oncall-next): Got it. I will pick up monitoring alerts and coordinate if the routing override expires. Please leave the command history & escalation notes in the incident doc.

tyler (support): Customers acknowledged receipt; a few replied with examples of problematic outputs. Uploading redacted examples to the incident folder.

maya (ml-eng): Uploaded eval diffs + reproducible script:
```
# reproduce locally
python reproduce.py --model redwood-v2-small-q8 --prompt-file samples/failing_prompts.json --quant=q8 --kv-debug
```

alex (oncall): Closing live mitigation thread. If any re-triggering happens, page PD-4721. Will update incident doc with timeline and attach logs. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread closed by alex at 1860123820.
